2026-11-20.title: NVIDIA reports after a change at the top
2026-11-20.synthesis: NVIDIA's earnings call on November 17 comes days after its board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation. The forecasts give both S&P 500 tails a little more weight than their long-run Friday-to-Friday frequencies. The case for wider moves is stronger than the case for either direction. Huang's return by Friday would be a surprise while the board searches for a successor.
2026-11-20.note: The opening note was added for this edition of the journal. The November 14 release holds the original forecasts.
